name: Baroness Imogen
source:
Wife of Charles (deceased) and now wife of [url=https://vndb.org/c165851]James[/url], his brother. Imogen's marriage to Charles, Baron of Felton. Her marriage to Charles was a match made in heaven. Not only did Imogen come with a large dowry, Imogen and Charles were truly in love. Charles' sudden death left the Barony in a quandary. The dowry was spent. A marriage to James was then arranged. Imogen and James' marriage has been fraught with difficulties.
